Independent, evidence-based education on non-surgical and surgical breast enlargement.

Independent patient education

Non-Surgical Breast Enlargement

Understand what changes appearance, what has evidence for lasting volume, and which breast-enlargement claims are unsupported or unsafe.

Home/Non-Surgical Breast Enlargement

Non-surgical does not mean proven or safe

Fillers are not FDA-approved for breast enlargement. Facial approval does not establish breast-use approval. Threads, PRP, biostimulators and regenerative products should not be presented as proven substitutes for augmentation. Fat transfer is surgery, even though it does not use an implant.
